cases.sentence: Щербацкий говорил ___ Николаевой, что он намерен надеть венец на шиньон Кити, чтоб она была счастлива.
cases.explain: «старой фрейлине» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Shtcherbatsky told the old maid of honor, Madame Nikolaeva, that he meant to put the crown on Kitty’s chignon for luck.

cases.sentence: – Не надо было надевать шиньона, – отвечала Николаева, давно решившая, что если ___, которого она ловила, женится на ней, то свадьба будет самая простая. – Я не люблю этот фаст.
cases.explain: «старый вдовец» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “She ought not to have worn a chignon,” answered Madame Nikolaeva, who had long ago made up her mind that if the elderly widower she was angling for married her, the wedding should be of the simplest. “I don’t like such grandeur.”

cases.sentence: И она также, чистая, стояла в ___ и вуале.
cases.explain: «померанцевых цветах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Dolly stood beside them; she heard them, but she did not answer. She was deeply moved. The tears stood in her eyes, and she could not have spoken without crying. She was rejoicing over Kitty and Levin; going back in thought to her own wedding, she glanced at the radiant figure of Stepan Arkadyevitch, forgot all the present, and remembered only her own innocent love. She recalled not herself only, but all her women-friends and acquaintances. She thought of them on the one day of their triumph, when they had stood like Kitty under the wedding crown, with love and hope and dread in their hearts, renouncing the past, and stepping forward into the mysterious future. Among the brides that came back to her memory, she thought too of her darling Anna, of whose proposed divorce she had just been hearing. And she had stood just as innocent in orange flowers and bridal veil. And now? “It’s terribly strange,” she said to herself. It was not merely the sisters, the women-friends and female relations of the bride who were following every detail of the ceremony. Women who were quite strangers, mere spectators, were watching it excitedly, holding their breath, in fear of losing a single movement or expression of the bride and bridegroom, and angrily not answering, often not hearing, the remarks of the callous men, who kept making joking or irrelevant observations.

cases.explain: «белом атласе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Is that her sister in the white satin? Just listen how the deacon booms out, ‘And fearing her husband.’ ”
